messages:
sarah-cs: FYI — CareBridge legal escalated. They need a narrow EOB CSV export for a subpoena. They want KMS key provenance (rotation history) and an HSM attestation for the exported file. They received a partial CSV; client saw 401 errors mid-stream. cc @olivia-sec @mike-sre

olivia-sec: @sarah-cs thanks. Please confirm the export job id and paste the raw 401 response if you have it. Need to know if 401 is our auth to KMS/S3 or the customer's client token.

sarah-cs: Job id: export-2026-04-01-21c9. Customer pasted this snippet from the client: ```HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
{
  \"error\": \"Unauthorized: token expired\"
}``` They say failures start after row ~7,100.

mike-sre: Looking now. Infra logs show KMS returned 403 on key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01 at 2026-04-01T21:07:03Z, not 401. The proxy in front of uploads sometimes returns 401 to clients while upstream is 403. Can you confirm the client-side exact body?

sarah-cs: Confirmed — their raw client logged 401. They ran for ~16 minutes and then rows started failing. Attached a tiny excerpt from the partial CSV they received: ```patient_id,claim_id,amount,date
1001,clm-0001,120.00,2024-12-01
1002,clm-0002,58.50,2024-12-03
...
```

kevin-eng: Could be presigned URL signing TTL. What's the export presign TTL and refresh behavior? @mike-sre

mike-sre: Default presign TTL is 900s. Long exports should refresh tokens; export-worker has a refresh but it looks like it failed after 3 retries and gave up. I'm seeing retry loop + final "giving up" in logs. Escalating to eng-runtime.

hana-eng-runtime: added. Can you drop the exact stack/log block here so I can reproduce quickly?

mike-sre: Pasting condensed log (trimmed): ```2026-04-01T21:06:58Z export-2026-04-01-21c9 chunk-3 presign-request -> 200
2026-04-01T21:09:59Z export-2026-04-01-21c9 chunk-16 upload -> 401 Unauthorized (s3-upload-gateway)
2026-04-01T21:10:00Z retry attempt 1
2026-04-01T21:10:25Z retry attempt 2
2026-04-01T21:11:00Z retry attempt 3 -> giving up
```

olivia-sec: OK. Regardless of root cause, CareBridge requires KMS provenance and HSM attestation for the delivered export. We can produce a signed manifest (sha256 + signature) and KMS rotation timestamps. HSM attestation is issued by security — I'll need the final file hash and the exact key ARNs used.

sarah-cs: They also want confirmation that deleted records outside the retention window were not included. Customer expects a CRC/sha and statement of retention policy applied.

kevin-eng: We can generate a signed manifest containing sha256, file size, KMS key ARN, and rotation window. HSM attestation is manual; @olivia-sec will sign with HSM cert. In parallel I'll look at code: presign refresh missing for long running multi-chunk exports.

olivia-sec: I can prepare a scoped HSM attestation referencing HSM serial HSM-SN-998877. Need final file hash + KMS rotation ledger excerpt for the key from 2024-09-01 to now. Once eng re-runs and provides the artifact, I can draft the attestation PDF. ETA ~90m after I get the hash.

lisa-finance: Looping in — customer was billed for the failed export attempts. We'll hold a credit decision until root cause confirmed. Please flag if it's an obvious platform error.

hana-eng-runtime: I reproduced locally by running export with --chunk-size 10000 and inducing jitter. Found presign tokens not refreshed when worker held state > TTL. PR with fix + tests in review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/export-service/pull/2314 (canary ready).

mike-sre: Deployed canary hotfix to export-service in us-east-1. @sarah-cs can you re-run with rerun job id so we have a fresh artifact to attest against?

sarah-cs: Re-run kicked off: export-2026-04-01-21c9-rerun. Customer watching. I'll post the file hash when done.

sarah-cs: Update — rerun completed, full CSV delivered. File manifest: ```filename: carebridge_eob_20260401.csv
size_bytes: 25873456
sha256: 3b7f9c8a1f4a2c6d9e7b4c3f5a2d1e0b8c9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b
```

olivia-sec: Received hash. I'll draft the attestation referencing KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01 and rotation timestamps (2024-09-01T00:00:00Z -> 2026-03-31T23:59:59Z) and HSM SN HSM-SN-998877. Deliverable: signed PDF with HSM cert chain. ETA ~90 minutes.

sarah-cs: Customer confirmed they received the file and accepted a bill credit offer. They need the attestation to close.

audit-bot: INC-2026-4387 created and linked. Artifacts saved to /secure/audits/INC-2026-4387: export job ids [export-2026-04-01-21c9, export-2026-04-01-21c9-rerun], logs, signed manifest, initial partial CSV.

olivia-sec: Attestation PDF uploaded to the ticket. Closing once finance confirms credit applied.

lisa-finance: Credit applied (one-time platform credit equal to failed attempt charges). Marking resolved from finance side.

sarah-cs: Closing thread. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
